description: This file defines the CandidateMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. Its purpose is to configure menu options for the recruitment module, specifically overriding the screen for viewing candidates within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: CandidateMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for candidate-related screens, overriding the default screen for viewing candidates.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default 'configure' method to set the screen to 'viewCandidates' for the current module.
